subject: [PATCH v6 11/12] mm, swap: add vmstat and memcg counters for vswap

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds two new counters to report virtual swap usage: 'vswap' in /proc/vmstat and a corresponding field in cgroup's memory.stat. These counters help diagnose swapping issues and provide userspace with information about the logical memory footprint of workloads.
